## Booking a Meeting Slot {-}

Book your group's seminar meeting in the online planner:

[Book a meeting slot](https://terminplaner.dfn.de/public/bookings/30d3a64c-356c-4dc3-82ca-a02fd46df1c0){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank" rel="noopener"}

::: {.spaced-list}
* **One slot per group per week.** 
    * Each slot takes up to three participants, and all of them must belong to the same group. Do not join a slot that a member of another group has already booked.
    * Do not reserve multiple slots in advance.  
* **Monday slots: in person or online.** 
    * You choose whether we meet in room HB-108 or via Zoom. After booking, send an email to [dominik.liebl@ku.de](mailto:dominik.liebl@ku.de) stating which option your group wants.
* **Tuesday slots: online only.** 
    * All Tuesday meetings take place via Zoom. No email is needed.
:::

All online meetings take place in this Zoom room:

[Join the Zoom meeting](https://kuei.zoom-x.de/j/66424019307){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank" rel="noopener"}

## Seminar Rules {-}

* **Groups:** two to three students each.
* **Grading:**
    * 80% seminar thesis
    * 20% presentation, in which *every* group member speaks.
* **Seminar thesis:**
    * **Length:** 8–12 pages main text, including figures and tables; title page, table of contents, references, and appendix do not count.
    * **Format:** PDF with 12 pt font, 1.5 line spacing, and 2.5 cm margins. The thesis templates (@sec-thesis) already meet these requirements.
    * **Code:** Only short snippets in the main text. Submit the full code separately so that all results can be reproduced (fixed random seed).
    * **Submission:** `thesis.pdf` and a ZIP file of your complete thesis folder (text, code, and literature). Deadline: TBA.
* **Exam registration (via [campus.KU](https://campus.ku.de/)) deadline:** January 21.

## Groups and Topics {-}

The groups are formed, and each group has its topic:

| Group | Topic |
|:--|:--|
| 1 | Linear & Ridge Regression Analysis |
| 2 | Nonparametric Density Estimation |
| 3 | (Multiple) Testing |

⚠️ Being assigned to a group does not replace the official course and exam registration via [campus.KU](https://campus.ku.de/).
